title: Documentation
subtitle: Build agent-ready systems from deterministic protocol contracts
description: Cardity Core documents the public protocol compiler API, MCP endpoint, CLI wrappers, Agent OS manifest flow, and the PMTSoul-validated projection contract v1.1.

learningPath.title: Learning Path
learningPath.description: Recommended path for teams adopting Cardity as an agent protocol layer:
steps: Describe the system contract as Cardity protocol source
Compile ABI, protocol JSON, Agent OS manifest, and schema-visible projection contracts
Expose the protocol through API, MCP, CLI, or SDK
Let pmtsoul-agent map and validate the manifest into API, database, read models, UI, workflows, and checks
Version ABI changes before agents regenerate production systems
